The test image shows a tomato leaf with:
- General chlorosis (yellowing)
- Numerous small, dark circular spots scattered across the surface
- Spots appear uniform in size, small (1-3mm range)

This pattern strongly suggests either Septoria Leaf Blotch or Bacterial Speck. I'll use my 1 reference view on Septoria Leaf Blotch, as the small circular spots with potential dark centers are characteristic.

The reference image for Septoria_Leaf_Blotch is a near-identical match to the test image:
- Same leaf shape and size
- Same yellowing/chlorosis pattern
- Same small dark circular spots scattered across the leaf surface
- Even the gray background and photo composition match

This is clearly Septoria Leaf Blotch.
